title: Positive: Security Access granted successfully in Programming Session
steps: Send Security Access key with valid calculated key: 27 ZZ XX XX
expected: Response to 27 YY: 67 YY XX XX (Seed provided)
Response to 27 ZZ: 67 ZZ (Security Access granted)

title: Negative: Security Access rejected in Extended Session
steps: Intentional abnormal condition - Request Security Access seed outside Programming Session: 27 YY
expected: Response to 27 YY: 7F 27 7E (SubFunctionNotSupportedInActiveSession) or 7F 27 31 (RequestOutOfRange) representing a violation if accepted

title: Negative: Security Access rejected due to Invalid Key in Programming Session
preconditions: Security access invalid attempt counter is at 0
steps: Intentional abnormal condition - Send Security Access key with incorrect data: 27 ZZ 00 00
expected: Response to 27 YY: 67 YY XX XX
postconditions: Security access invalid attempt counter incremented by 1

title: Negative: Security Access rejected due to missing Seed request (Sequence Error)
steps: Intentional abnormal condition - Send Security Access key without prior seed request: 27 ZZ XX XX

title: Negative: Security Access locked out after exceeding maximum attempts
preconditions: Security access invalid attempt counter reached maximum value
steps: Intentional abnormal condition - Request Security Access seed when lockout is active: 27 YY
postconditions: Security delay timer (S4) is active and running
